name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Bessent reportedly tells Russia no economic relief until Ukraine war ends as Europe snubs Moscow at G20
changes.summary: The meeting underscored Washington's willingness to reopen diplomatic talks with Moscow, as Europe intends to isolate the nation while the war continues.

changes.title: Summit With Russia, India and Iran Shows Leverage Wars Have Given Xi of China
changes.summary: A two-day conference of the 10-nation Shanghai Cooperation Organization in Kyrgyzstan shows the limits of U.S. economic warfare.

changes.title: Russian drones kill a woman and 9-year-old son at home as Ukrainian civilian casualties surge
changes.summary: This attack comes after the United Nations reported that July was the deadliest month for Ukrainian civilians since the early weeks of Russia's invasion.

changes.title: Russia Campaigned to Derail Moldova’s Pro-Western Government
changes.summary: In Moldova, Moscow paid Orthodox priests, conducted a vote-buying scheme and set up training camps on election interference — all in an effort to derail the Western-leaning government.

changes.title: Trump Gives Green Light to U.S. Companies to Aim Hacks at Cybercriminals
changes.summary: The practice would align the United States more closely with countries like China and Russia, where spy agencies have long relied on private-sector hackers to help with national security missions.

changes.title: Putin Visits Islands Seized From Japan in World War II, Angering Tokyo
changes.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi of Japan has been a public critic of Mr. Putin, who has denounced her country’s sanctions against Russia over the Ukraine war.

changes.title: Poland says it thwarted Russian plot to kill an American citizen in a NATO country
changes.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it marks the first time Russia sought to attack an American citizen in another NATO country.

changes.title: By sky and sea, Ukraine's drone strikes challenge Russia's grip on Crimea
changes.summary: Russia maintained an iron grip on Crimea since seizing it from Ukraine in 2014. Many Russian civilians go there to enjoy the beaches. But now Ukraine is hitting Crimea hard, upending daily life. (Image credit: Igor Ivanko).

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
